'''Krags''' were very large herd animals native to [[Frithia]], capable of trampling [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] to [[Death/Legends|death]]. They were domesticated over [[Time/Legends|time]] by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] colonists of the [[Planet/Legends|world]].

Many Zabrak [[Gender/Legends|males]] were named after the [[Species/Legends|species]].
